To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Gauge Equivariant Graph CNNs are a generalization of GCNs and that they are more expressive than GCNs.
We propose Gauge Equi-variant Mesh CNNs which extend graph convolutions to apply anisot-ropic, gauge equivariant kernels to mesh vertices and edges.

1) Gauge equivariant mesh CNNs generalize GCNs to use anisotropic kernels; 2) The resulting features encode orientation information, which can be exploited by a geometric message passing algorithm to improve expressivity; 3) Experiments validate that the proposed model is significantly more expressive than conventional GCNs, as well as other state-of-the-art methods.

geometric information can be captured by a simple message passing scheme and that anisotropic convolutions are essential for capturing this information.
